answer: The cedar register is checked at draw time, mirror lists the eligible set, and reef seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 56 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 56 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an copycat pays for every seat it wants. A 159 account operation therefore ties up 33 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
